acceptance_criteria.statement: After a story edit is committed, Git-backed query history identifies the real commits and authors; the prior and current complete definitions can be inspected from those commits.
Committed state changes and their authored reasons remain inspectable through Git history; Saga stores only the current state and reason.

content.statement: As a product manager, I can inspect the complete evolution of a story's definition and lifecycle so I can understand decisions without losing earlier intent.
content.title: Inspect requirement evolution
